label: Gunlance
note: MHFU Gunlance meta is built around Sharpness +1, Razor Sharp (Sharp Sword), Gunnery King (the game's Artillery skill), and Guard +1/2, with shelling type and level (Long 4, Spread 4, etc.) doing much of the damage. This preset only represents Sharpness +1; Razor Sharp, Gunnery King/Artillery, Guard, ESP, and shelling level are unmodeled, and Attack Up/Crit Eye are low priority because shells ignore them.
